protocol.primary_population: fresh unique puzzles generated after protocol freeze, independent solution families under audited D4/digit normalizations
protocol.primary_metric: Per-puzzle mean decoder NLL on initially empty Sudoku cells; references used only for scoring. Conditional on frozen hard checkpoint.
protocol.inference: Paired puzzle percentile bootstrap 4000 draws; 95% descriptive intervals and 97.5% Bonferroni intervals for two co-primary contrasts. Positive compensation claim requires both co-primary 97.5% lower bounds above zero on fresh puzzles; no universal or cognitive claim.
protocol.random_control: Independent Gaussian direction per puzzle, same norm as adapted-minus-native tail sum; readout only, descriptive control.
protocol.text_level0: Official saved unigram, sampled separately per trajectory seed; native eager generate, no custom generator runner.
protocol.text_readout: Raw decoder argmax at every cumulative level; separate official final frequency/adjacency postprocessing for examples only.
protocol.text_observable: All 128 positions, no ground-truth text: adoption of final raw token at a transition then abandonment at an intermediate later level. Final token is a retrospective anchor, not correctness. Report all transitions; 8->9 primary descriptive reference to Sudoku, not scale equivalence.
protocol.text_oracle_control: First 128 previously selected random LM1B validation rows, reused exploratory observations; non-PAD mask. Native generation is unconditional and not paired to these references.
protocol.scope: No attention patching or disambiguating puzzles. New study preserves all earlier files. Paper narrative depends on measured effects; no universal NCM claim from Sudoku and one LM1B generator.
